values./system/biography:
A giant two-headed rattlesnake created by Zetan experimentation.

Butchery: END + Survival, difficulty 1; yields 2 DC portions of mutant rattler meat and 2 common materials. An Effect also yields one giant two-headed rattlesnake fang (Machete); two Effects instead allow harvesting a poison sack containing 2 ammo of Rattler venom.
values./items/@55817b80582020a5/system/descript: It may make two Bite attacks in a single turn.
values./items/@c3ead089d805fbc5/system/descript: Once per combat, it may use a minor action to give its Bite the Stun effect for the turn.
values./items/@874f27668b728ecd/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@cc88320becd3eb20/system/descript: The Twinjaw Rattler gains +1 HP per level (included), has Defense reduced by 1 to a minimum of 1, and only suffers a Critical Hit from 7+ damage after resistance.
